<p><a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/about-council/council-meetings/documents/meeting_procedures_and_standing_orders_for_the_conduct_of_council_meetings_and_standing_committees___23_april_2025.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Meeting Procedures and Standing Orders for Council Meetings and Standing Committees<span class="file-info">(PDF, 499KB)</span></a></p>

</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Community Presentations before Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Members of the public are provided an opportunity to address Council about matters of concern during <em>Community Presentations</em>, held <strong>from 9:00am to 9:30am</strong> before each Ordinary Council Meeting.</p>
<p>Presentations must follow the protocols outlined in the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/3/about-council/council-meetings/documents/community-presentations-to-councillors-council-policy-4386332.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Community Presentation to Councillors Council Policy.<span class="file-info">(PDF, 172KB)</span></a> and <a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/about-council/council-meetings/community-presentations/documents/community-presentations-organisational-procedure-5339532.pdf" target="_blank" title="Community-Presentations-Organisational-Procedure.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Community Presentations to Councillors Organisational Procedure<span class="file-info">(PDF, 173KB)</span></a>.</p>
<h3><strong>How to Nominate</strong></h3>
<p>You must register <strong>at least 3 business days before</strong> the meeting by one of the following methods:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.frasercoast.qld.gov.au/About-Council/Council-Meetings/Community-Presentations" target="_self">Complete the online nomination form</a></li>
<li>Call Customer Service on <strong>1300 79 49 29</strong></li>
<li>Visit any Council Customer Service Centre</li>
</ul>
<p>Successful presenters will be notified of their allocated presentation time via email within one business day after nominations close.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Petitions</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>A Council petition is a formal written request signed by at least 10 people, asking Council to take action on a particular issue or expressing support or objection to a decision or matter.</p>
<p>Petitions relating to an active development application during the public notification stage will be treated as formal submissions on the application.</p>
<h3><strong>Petition Requirements</strong></h3>
<p>In line with Fraser Coast Regional Council’s <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/about-council/council-meetings/documents/meeting_procedures_and_standing_orders_for_the_conduct_of_council_meetings_and_standing_committees___23_april_2025.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Meeting Procedures and Standing Orders<span class="file-info">(PDF, 499KB)</span></a>, all petitions must:</p>
<ul>
<li>Be legible (handwritten or typed) and contain at least 10 signatures</li>
<li>Include the name and contact details of the principal petitioner (organiser)</li>
<li>List the postcode of every petitioner</li>
<li>Have the petition request clearly stated on each page</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>How do I submit a petition to Council?</strong></h3>
<p>It is recommended to use the <strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/about-council/council-meetings/documents/petition_lodgement_form.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Petition Lodgement Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 1MB)</span></a></strong> to ensure all required information is included.</p>
<p>Once your petition is ready, you can submit it to Council via any of the following options:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>In person:</strong> Submit at any Council Customer Service Centre</li>
<li><strong>By post:</strong> PO Box 1943, Hervey Bay QLD 4655</li>
<li><strong>Through your Divisional Councillor</strong></li>
<li><strong>By email:</strong> <a href="mailto:enquiry@frasercoast.qld.gov.au">enquiry@frasercoast.qld.gov.au</a></li>
</ol>
<p>An e-petition or online petition will be accepted but must be downloaded and submitted via one of the above options.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
